scope: Read-only review narrowed to existing source-build log2 family wiring; no other math-family implementation work and no native run
source_wiring_verdict: The observed two CMake changes correctly replace the scaled-log legacy double implementation with the existing complete Apple BASE2 implementation, while retaining existing nonlegacy xmm_log extra definitions.

observed_changes.global_macro_retained: BUILDING_FOR_CARBONCORE_LEGACY selects only BASE2 in log.S; despite its name, here it is a packaging selector, not the approximate algorithm

symbol_ownership.note: Only BASE2 is instantiated under the existing global macro; keep that macro on this assembler source. The existing libmathCommonIntel.alias supplies the $fenv_access_off alias.
Removing the legacy main object is safe only while retaining this extra. Float fallbacks inside this C file are commented out.
Independent existing table/reduction algorithm, not the scaled-log fallback; power-of-two branch explicitly avoids inexact.
Despite file name log2.S, it exports long double log2l only: stack long-double argument and x87 result. No duplicate double log2.

abi_assessment: New double implementation reads and returns XMM0 on x86_64. Its temporary x87 result is explicitly rounded/stored to double and returned in XMM0; ordinary-path x87 temporaries are popped.

Existing float path uses XMM0 with cvtsd2ss conversion; existing long-double path retains its original stack input and x87 return ABI. No wrappers, new symbols or alternate calling convention are needed.

CMake change does not remove or alter the existing fenv.c implementation. Keep global CPU/ASM flags and alias lists unchanged; do not silently disable SSE denormal handling or alter caller rounding controls.
Both shared and static targets use libm_sources, while system_m_extra remains included in both. Static alias/archive behavior is inherited from the existing build, not independently revalidated here.

necessary_targeted_validation.cases: Compare complete before/after libsystem_m export names, including ordinary and $fenv_access_off log2/f/l; ensure one strong definition per public name and original log/log1p/log10 are retained. Confirm actual ld log2 call resolves to the source-built new implementation.

Reuse existing 2098 double-power input control; include float powers spanning -149..127 and long-double powers representable by its real ABI, including subnormals. Confirm log2(16384)==14 exactly and no FE_INEXACT on exact cases in the default environment.

Use a small deterministic set of nonpowers, nextafter neighbors of 1/powers, minimum normal/subnormal and large finite values. Compare with the existing complete Apple math oracle using a stated ULP tolerance; powers alone bypass most of the new routine.

At least nearest/up/down/towardzero for representative exact and inexact values; record zero/negative/infinity/qNaN/sNaN outcomes, FE_DIVBYZERO/FE_INVALID/FE_INEXACT and preservation of control modes/x87 stack balance. Source NaN path ucomisd then jp9f/ret should be measured before claiming IEEE equivalence.

Reuse the already prepared minimal original direct/UBA ld oslogstring link plus the original rsp path, then final original xcodebuild. Do not replace these with a synthetic success marker or rerun unrelated engine matrices.

existing_binary_oracle_assessment.dependencies: libdyld, libcompiler_rt, weak libsystem_pthread; only five actual binds: weak ____chkstk_darwin plus ___muldc3/___mulsc3/___mulxc3/___truncdfhf2.
existing_binary_oracle_assessment.recommendation: Keep this existing complete original image as the numeric/ABI oracle and existing SIMD provider. The source-level log2 selection fix is smaller and preserves the current full libm provider. A full provider replacement is unnecessary for this family fix and is not implied by 534 matching export names.
existing_binary_oracle_assessment.prior_native_evidence: runtime/original-simd-math-test-fovwwg9_/result.json: existing legacy 364 failures among 2098 powers; original Apple reference 0 failures. This review did not rerun it.
